summary: Template indexer cascade: SLA/routing macros detached after nightly reindex
description:
Issue summary: After the nightly template-indexer run (v2.9.1) we observed a cascade of detached macro-to-SLA bindings resulting in low-priority cases being routed to default queues instead of the intended escalation paths.

Impact: Approximately 12 routing templates across multiple teams lost their SLA weightings and macro associations. Customers on Dedicated and Private tiers reported longer initial response times for tickets created after the indexer window.

Observed behavior: Indexer job completes successfully in logs but the template binding table (template_bindings_v2) contains stale object IDs; the UI and routing-engine reconcile step mark templates as "orphaned". Automated rollbacks were attempted but the reconciliation task re-applied incorrect macro IDs from an older snapshot.

Expected behavior: Nightly indexer should update template lookup tables without changing macro IDs or SLA weightings. Reconciliation should preserve existing bindings when a clear owner mapping exists.
steps_to_reproduce: 1. Trigger nightly template-indexer (simulated with indexer --dry-run omitted) using snapshot from 2026-02-28
2. Observe template_bindings_v2 before job: macros and sla_weights present for templates TPL-100..TPL-112
3. Run indexer v2.9.1 against the snapshot; check logs at /var/log/indexer/2026-03-01.log
4. After job: templates TPL-103, TPL-107, TPL-110 show macro_id=null in DB and UI flags them as Orphaned
5. Routing-engine then falls back to default queue causing misrouted tickets in support ingestion telemetry
impact: Customer-facing routing misassignments leading to delayed responses; estimated increase in median TTR (time-to-respond) by ~27% for affected templates during the window. No data loss; primarily operational/regression impact.
investigation_notes: 2026-03-01 03:40 - On-call noticed surge in routing defaults in us-east; support alerted SRE.
2026-03-01 04:00 - Pulled indexer logs: indexer reported successful commit, but post-commit reconciliation logged UID mismatches for 14 entries.
2026-03-01 05:10 - Ran DB diff between pre/post snapshots; macro_id canonicalization step replaced newer GUIDs with legacy GUIDs present in fallback snapshot.
2026-03-02 09:20 - Correlation with deployment: indexer v2.9.1 included a heuristic to dedupe macro objects by name which incorrectly matched macros across namespaces.
2026-03-03 11:05 - Confirmed UI read path shows detached bindings; routing-engine metrics show increased default_queue hits for templates list.
2026-03-04 08:30 - Workaround: paused nightly indexer schedule and queued a manual rebind operation to restore correct macro IDs for affected templates. Manual rebind success rate: 12/12.
2026-03-05 14:00 - Added integration test to catch macro canonicalization regressions; test failing on master reproduces mapping swap.
comments: Support (2026-03-01) - Asha Patel: Customer reports - multiple tickets routed to default queue. Started investigation; escalated to SRE. Linked slack thread #support-indexer.
SRE (2026-03-01) - Marco Ruiz: Initial findings: indexer commit completed but node reconciliation replaced macro GUIDs. Pulling indexer artifacts and DB snapshots for deeper diff.

Eng (2026-03-02) - Priya Desai: Root cause hypothesis: dedupe-by-name heuristic introduced in v2.9.1 incorrectly ignores namespace field; creating PR to add namespace back to comparison key. Refer PR: github.com/redwood-inference/indexer/pull/4510.

Support (2026-03-04) - Claire Nguyen: Workaround applied: paused scheduled indexer and executed manual rebind job ID RB-20260304-1; monitoring routing metrics. Customers notified with temporary expectations.
SRE (2026-03-05) - Marco Ruiz: Manual rebind validated in prod; no further orphans observed after rebind. Leaving ticket open while fix is rolled out and additional tests are merged.
resolution: Workaround: nightly indexer schedule paused (2026-03-04) and manual rebind executed to restore macro associations. Root cause identified as namespace-agnostic dedupe heuristic in indexer v2.9.1.
fix_plan: 1) Patch: Revert dedupe-by-name change and add namespace in comparison key (owner: Priya Desai) - PR #4510. Target merge: 2026-03-06
2) Tests: Add integration test that exercises cross-namespace macro collisions (owner: QA infra) - due 2026-03-05
3) Canary: Deploy patched indexer to staging and run a full reindex against the 2026-03-01 snapshot. Monitor template_bindings_v2 diffs (owner: Marco Ruiz) - window 2026-03-07
4) Rollout: Gradual rollout to prod with indexer scheduler re-enabled only after validation (owner: Release Eng) - target 2026-03-09
5) Postmortem & runbook update: Document safe-index migration steps and add automatic pre/post diff validation (owner: Claire Nguyen) - due 2026-03-12
